public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the

what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

- The Partnership's last periodic annual report on EDGAR is a Form 10-K filed
  2018-02-05, covering the fiscal year ended November 30, 2017, i.e. before the closing
  of the merger. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-18-001014, Form 10-K]
- On June 28, 2018, the Partnership filed a Form 15-12B certifying termination of
  registration of its Class A shares under Section 12(g) of the Exchange Act and
  suspension of its duty to file reports under Sections 13(a)/15(d), recording
  approximately 1 holder of record as of the certification date. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-18-008779, Form 15-12B]
- A listing of the registrant's (CIK 0001635581) EDGAR filings by form type (10-K, 10-Q,
  8-K, 15-12B) finds no filing of any kind dated after the June 28, 2018 Form 15-12B; no
  periodic report covering fiscal years within the ~2021-2023 outcome window was filed.
  [SRC: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001635581&type=10-K]
- No public audited financial statements are available for the acquired solar-generation
  portfolio for the ~2021-2023 window. The acquirer, Capital Dynamics, Inc., is a private,
  independent global asset manager; no SEC filing or other primary source was located in
  which it separately discloses this specific acquired business's post-close financial or
  operating trajectory, and it is under no obligation as a private manager to do so.
  [UNVERIFIED]

## Items sought but not found
- A targeted search for reputable-press reporting on the acquired portfolio's (or
  individual project) status, sale, refinancing, or impairment under Capital Dynamics
  ownership within the ~2021-2023 window did not locate any such report; available press
  coverage concerns only the 2017-2018 acquisition announcement and closing, not any
  subsequent event. [UNVERIFIED]
- No reputable-press or primary source was located reporting a divestiture, write-down,
  bankruptcy, or comparable outcome scalar specifically tied to the Capital
  Dynamics-owned former-8point3 solar portfolio within the ~2021-2023 window. [UNVERIFIED]
- Third-party company-profile aggregators carry entries referencing the 2018 transaction,
  but none of the aggregator content located discloses a post-2018 operating or financial
  trajectory for the specific acquired portfolio, and aggregator content is not a primary
  source in any case. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Because 8point3 Energy Partners LP was taken private and deregistered its securities in
  June 2018, there is no public audited outcome record (10-K) for the ~2021-2023 window
  for the acquired solar-generation business itself. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-18-008779, Form 15-12B]
- No reputable-press report documenting a discrete post-close factual event (sale,
  refinancing, impairment, or similar) specific to the acquired portfolio within the
  fixed outcome window was located. [UNVERIFIED]
- Per the no-record convention, this case is coded **uncertain** on the outcome for the
  acquired business: the absence of any public periodic-reporting record, combined with
  the absence of any located reputable-press account of a discrete post-close event
  specific to this portfolio, precludes a sourced determination of the realized 3-5-year
  trajectory of the specific acquired asset base.

[SLICE END]
